svg.text: ESP32 DevKit V1 · power via TPS63020 3.3 V buck-boost · sensors on the 3.3 V rail
All “3.3V” flags are the same net: TPS63020 OUT → ESP32 3V3. All ground symbols share the GND rail (TP4056 OUT−).
The battery must never connect to ESP32 VIN/5V. Switch the collar off before plugging in the ESP32's micro-USB.
